title: Affine etale chart presentations of algebraic-space blowups
statement: Let $S$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], and $X$ an algebraic space over $S$ with its small etale structure sheaf [def-trf-algebraic-space], in the universes of [def-weil-size-convention]. Let $\mathcal I$ be a quasi-coherent ideal [def-sfb-space-quasi-coherent-ideal], with quasi-coherence [def-trf-space-quasi-coherent-module]. On a scheme chart $V\to X$, restrict its inclusion to Zariski opens using [def-trf-space-module-scheme-restriction]; its ideals of sections, as in [def-sfb-space-ideal-power-products], determine a quasi-coherent scheme ideal $I_V$. A blowup presentation of $\mathcal I$ consists of an algebraic space $B$, a projection $b:B\to X$, and the requirement that for every affine etale scheme chart $V\to X$, the square from the ordinary scheme blowup $\operatorname{Bl}_{I_V}(V)$ [def-nagata-global-blowup] to $B$, over $V\to X$, is cartesian. Thus it presents the etale-descent relative Rees Proj up to isomorphism over $X$. For a map $p:Y\to X$, a quasi-coherent ideal $\mathcal J$ on $Y$, and an open subspace $U$ [def-a1-space-open-subspace], define $\mathcal J$ to be unit above $U$ when its ideal of sections on every etale scheme chart $W\to Y$ whose composite factors through $U$ is the full structure ring. This is exactly $\mathcal J|_{p^{-1}U}=\mathcal O_{p^{-1}U}$.
